description_en: Queries the details of a specified OTA update batch
description_zh: 调用该接口查询指定升级批次的详情
kebab_example: aliyun iot query-ota-job --iot-instance-id iot-cn-0pp1n8t0000 --job-id wahVIzGkCMuAUE2gDERM020000 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: QueryOTAJob

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. On the Overview page in the IoT Platform console, you can view the ID of the current instance.

<notice>
If this value is available, you must specify it. Otherwise, the call fails.
If no <props="intl"><ph>Overview page or </ph></props>ID value is available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无<props="intl"><ph>实例概览页面或</ph></props>ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the update batch.

This is the JobId returned after you call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/147480.html, https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/147496.html, or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/147887.html to create an update batch. You can also view this value on the Update Package Details page in the IoT Platform console
parameters.help_zh:
升级批次ID。

您调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/147480.html、https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/147496.html或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/147887.html创建升级任务批次后，返回的**JobId**。您也可以在物联网平台控制台的**升级包详情**页面查看
parameters.name: job_id
